ambiguities.description: Is enrollment itself tracked as a distinct fact independent of grades, or is grade-receiving the only recorded evidence of enrollment? The transcript mentions 'Students enroll in course offerings' as a separate statement from grade assignment, but no enrollment date or status attributes are given. Should Enrollment be objectified with its own attributes (e.g., enrollment date, status), or is it sufficient as a plain fact type?

ambiguities.description: Is the same Course allowed to have multiple offerings within the same Semester, or only across different semesters? The transcript only confirms multiple offerings across different semesters (Fall and Spring), leaving same-semester multiplicity unclear. This affects whether Course+Semester should have a uniqueness constraint on CourseOffering.

source_references.excerpt: Intro to Databases might run in both Fall and Spring.
